description: Removes the lanes, vehicles, cases, envelopes and groups a cs454_moving_loads run wrote, using the plugin's own cleanup (cases and envelopes first, bottom up, at most 100 per call): anything edited since the run, or still used by something else, is kept. Previews unless apply: true.
name: cs454_moving_loads_undo
title: Undo a CS454 moving-load run
